fidelity_delivery.rationale: The accepted shape explicitly requires a small interaction, and the delivery remains a contained dependency-free vertical slice.

destination.technology_rationale: One dependency-free HTML file is sufficient to exercise the interaction, routing, refusal, and summary behaviors.

implementation_summary: A local form collects the three required inputs, shows missing fields, separates standard and exception review, and creates a copyable summary that keeps approval human-owned.

verification.command_or_method: Parse and inspect the dependency-free HTML document
verification.evidence: The example validator confirms the expected controls, script, and human-decision text are present.

verification.command_or_method: Inspect labels, keyboard-native controls, live status, viewport, and color-independent text
verification.evidence: All inputs have visible labels; controls are native; results use aria-live and explicit text.

scenario_coverage.evidence: Complete standard input produces the standard-review summary.
Missing required values produce a specific gap list and no summary.
Urgent or exceptional input routes to human exception review.
No approval action exists and the result states that no approval was made.
The summary is generated and copyable, but actual reviewer usability requires representative-user evidence.

instrumentation: Visible status and missing-field feedback only; no telemetry or persistence
assumptions: A modern browser supports the clipboard API or provides the visible fallback
